title: Three Terms and One Short Cover
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：journal　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 journal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the novelist ① kept the journal that no student in the library would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the term. The ② journal, meaning the diary itself and not the cover, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; a journal, he said, is the only thing in a library that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ journal in that library had the same short cover beside it, and the ④ journal at the far desk, meaning the entry they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A journal, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the novelist said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the journal was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the diary. The ⑥ journal, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; journal, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a diary and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ journal had become a line in a page, and the page had become an argument about the short cover. The ⑧ journal of the whole thing, the novelist wrote in March, was one library and three terms of recording; journal, he said, is either the entry at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ journal I remember is the diary recorded in the page, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the library. A ⑩ journal, my mother said in 1985, is the only diary that improves by being recorded; every journal, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like a diary. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 日记；期刊（指图书馆里每一本旁边的那一本）
B. n. 日记；期刊（指那本日志本身，与封面相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the journal 记这本日记
D. n. 日记；期刊（指留给孩子们抄的一则那一本）
E. n. 记述之事（抽象总称，指一处图书馆的日记之事）
F. n. 日记；期刊（指册页里写到、被记下的的那一本）
G. n. 真实、本心（指一件事里人人都写却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 本心（抽象总称，指人人都写却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the journal that no student in the library would have recorded
The journal, meaning the diary itself and not the cover
the journal at the far desk
the journal was the whole of the matter
the journal had become a line in a page
The journal of the whole thing
A journal, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: keep the journal 意为“记这本日记”，1976 年那位小说家把图书馆里没有一位学生肯记录的一本日记做了一遍。
journal 意为“日记；期刊”，指那本日志本身而不是封面，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记录。
journal 意为“日记；期刊”，指图书馆里每一本旁边的那一本，每一本旁边都有同一张薄薄的封面。
journal 意为“日记；期刊”，指最远那张书桌留给孩子们抄的一则那一本，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
journal 意为“真实、本心”，指一件事里人人都写却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份真实就是那件事的全部。
journal 意为“本心”，指人人都写却无人提起的那样东西而不是那本日志，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
journal 意为“日记；期刊”，指册页里写到、被记下的的那一本，到 1981 年这一本成了册页里的一行。
journal 意为“记述之事”，小说家三月写道，整件事的日记之事是一处图书馆和三个学期的记录。
journal 意为“日记；期刊”，我记得的是册页里记录过的那一本，1983 年写完了，至今仍被说成图书馆里最安静的一本。
journal 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，日记是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的日志。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位小说家记了图书馆里没有一位学生肯记录的一本日记，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（keep the journal）
那本日记，指的是那本日志本身而不是封面，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记录。（journal）
